goal: {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool} (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (c : Cfg k Bool S x) : M.runFrom c 0 = c
{k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool} (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (c : Cfg k Bool S x) : M.runFrom c 1 = M.step c
: bufferTape ([] : List Bool) 0 = none
: bufferTape [true] 0 = some true
{k : ℕ} {S : Type} (m : SignType) (q : S) : (inputMoveAction (k := k) m q : Action k Bool S) = Action.mk m (fun _ => (none, 0)) none (some q)
{k : ℕ} {S : Type} (m : SignType) (q : S) : (inputMoveAction (k := k) m q : Action k Bool S).state = some q

{k : ℕ} {S : Type} (i : Fin k) (m s : SignType) (w : Option (Option Bool)) (q : S) : (tapeAction i m w s q : Action k Bool S) = Action.mk m (fun j => if j = i then (w, s) else (none, 0)) none (some q)
{k : ℕ} {S : Type} (i : Fin k) (m s : SignType) (w : Option (Option Bool)) (q : S) : (tapeAction i m w s q : Action k Bool S).state = some q
{k : ℕ} {S : Type} (m : SignType) (q : Option S) : (controlAction (k := k) m q : Action k Bool S) = Action.mk m (fun _ => (none, 0)) none q
{k : ℕ} {S : Type} (m : SignType) (q : Option S) : (controlAction (k := k) m q : Action k Bool S).state = q
{k : ℕ} {S T : Type} (f : S → T) (a : Action k Bool S) : a.mapState f = Action.mk a.inputTape a.workTapes a.output (a.state.map f)
{k : ℕ} {S T : Type} (f : S → T) (a : Action k Bool S) : (a.mapState f).state = a.state.map f
{k : ℕ} {A : Type} (δ : A → Bool → A) (a₀ : A) : (inputFoldTM k δ a₀).q₀ = .fwd a₀

{k : ℕ} {A : Type} (δ : A → Bool → A) (a₀ a : A) (inp : Option Bool) (work : Fin k → Option Bool) : (inputFoldTM k δ a₀).tr (.bwd a) inp work = (match inp with | some _ => inputMoveAction (-1) (.bwd a) | none => inputMoveAction 1 (.done a))
: blankCfg.inputSymbol = none
: ({blankCfg with inputPos := 1} : Cfg 0 Bool Unit []).inputSymbol = none
{k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool} (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (c : Cfg k Bool S x) : M.step {c with state := none} = {c with state := none}
{k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool} (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (c : Cfg k Bool S x) : M.step c = match c.state with | none => c | some q => (M.tr q c.inputSymbol c.workTapeSymbols).apply c
: moveInputPos (0 : Fin 2) 0 = 0
: moveInputPos (1 : Fin 2) 0 = 1
{k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool} (c : Cfg k Bool S x) (i : Fin k) : c.workTapeSymbols i = c.workTapes i (c.workTapePos i)
{k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool} (c : Cfg k Bool S x) : c.workTapeSymbols = (fun i => c.workTapes i (c.workTapePos i))
